record.dic_text:
07506 Rephach {reh'-fakh}

字根已不使用, 顯然其意為"支持","支撐"; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Rephah 1; 1

利法 = "生息的恢復"
1) 約書亞的後裔, 以法蓮的眾子之一 (#代上 7:25|和合本譯作比利阿的兒子, 
   欽定本譯比利阿和利法都是以法蓮的兒子)
record.edic_text:
07506 Rephach {reh'-fakh}

from an unused root apparently meaning to sustain;; n pr m

AV - Rephah 1; 1

Rephah = "healing of the breath"
1) son of Ephraim and a ancestor of Joshua
